summary: Moderately healthy modernization platform with strong architectural foundations but lacking legacy system integration clarity. High modularity and schema-driven design provide good maintainability, but missing banking domain specifics and unclear OCX retirement path present risks.

hotspots.reason: High complexity with 25 imports suggests potential over-coupling and single responsibility violations
File-based tenant isolation may not scale and lacks transactional guarantees for banking operations

provenance.evidence: JSON file-based storage for tenant data

hotspots.reason: Context vault endpoints lack visible authentication and authorization controls

provenance.evidence: FastAPI endpoints without visible auth decorators

hotspots.reason: No visible integration points or adapters for legacy banking systems and OCX components

provenance.evidence: No VB6, OCX, or legacy banking system artifacts detected

risks.title: Missing Legacy System Integration
risks.description: No visible adapters or integration points for legacy VB6 banking application or OCX components, creating a gap between modernization platform and target systems

risks.title: Banking Compliance Gaps
risks.description: No evidence of banking-specific compliance controls, audit trails, or regulatory reporting capabilities required for retail banking operations

risks.title: Data Persistence Scalability
risks.description: File-based tenant memory storage lacks ACID properties and scalability required for production banking workloads

risks.title: Authentication Architecture Unclear
risks.description: No clear authentication strategy visible for banking customer authentication, session management, or multi-factor authentication requirements
